definition_zh: 人类（总称）；仁厚；人性；人文学科
definition_en: people taken as a whole, or the quality of being kind and civilized
core_image: 洪水退去后的渡口：撑船的人不问来处，只把人一个个接上岸
scene: 洪水退去，邻村的人撑船来接陌生人，谁也不登记姓名。The rescuers showed a humanity that no border could contain.
sceneCN: 这里「仁厚」指待人以怜悯与尊重的品质（第 2 个义项：仁厚品质）；句意为救援者表现出一种任何边界都装不下的仁厚。

pos.zh: 人类（总称，不可数）；仁厚；人性；复数 humanities 指人文学科

derivatives.zh: humanity 的形容词基座：拉丁 humanus「人的」→ 人的；人
humanus 经法语较早借入 → 仁慈的（语义偏移：只留「善待」一义）
human + -ism（主义）→ 人文主义（语义偏移：以人的学问与价值为中心）
humanity + -arian → 人道主义的；人道主义者
in-（否定）+ humanity → 无人性；残忍（语义偏移：仁厚的反面）
humanity 的复数 → 人文学科（语义偏移：从「人性」到「研究人的表达的那些学问」）

senses.title: People as a whole
senses.titleCN: 人类总称：作为一个整体的全体人
senses.definition: human beings considered collectively, especially in relation to their future or survival
senses.definitionCN: 作为整体来看的全体人，尤就未来与存续而言
senses.example: The rescuers showed a humanity that no border could contain.
senses.exampleCN: 救援者表现出一种任何边界都装不下的仁厚。
senses.why: Latin humanitas could name the whole of the human race as well as its better qualities; English kept both, so the same word can mean everyone and the best in everyone.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 humanitas 既能指整个人类，也能指人较好的品质；英语两义都保留，因此同一个词既可指所有人，也可指人身上最好的部分。

senses.title: Kindness toward others
senses.titleCN: 仁厚：待人的怜悯与尊重
senses.definition: the quality of treating others with compassion and respect
senses.definitionCN: 以怜悯与尊重对待他人的品质
senses.example: She met the prisoners with a humanity the guards had forgotten.
senses.exampleCN: 她以看守们已经忘掉的仁厚对待囚犯。
senses.why: Cicero used humanitas for the refinement that makes a person fit company for others; the modern sense narrows that to warmth of treatment.
senses.whyCN: 西塞罗用 humanitas 指使人适于与人相处的教养；现代义把这层教养收窄为待人时的温度。

senses.title: Human nature
senses.definition: the shared nature or condition of human beings
senses.definitionCN: 人所共有的本性或处境
senses.example: The story tests whether humanity is generous when no one is watching.
senses.exampleCN: 这个故事追问：无人看见时，人性是否仍然宽厚。
senses.why: If humanitas is what belongs to homo, it can name the common constitution of people rather than their deeds; philosophers then argue about how much of it is fixed.
senses.whyCN: 若 humanitas 是「属于人」的东西，它就可以指人共有的构造，而非具体行为；哲学家由此争论其中多少是固定的。

senses.title: The humanities
senses.titleCN: 人文学科：研究人的表达的那些学问
senses.definition: the branches of learning that study human expression, such as literature, history and philosophy
senses.definitionCN: 研究人类表达的诸学问，如文学、历史与哲学
senses.example: He moved from law into the humanities and never regretted it.
senses.exampleCN: 他从法律转向人文学科，从未后悔。
senses.why: Renaissance Latin used literae humaniores, 'the more human letters'; the plural humanities kept that claim that such studies make a person more fully human.
senses.whyCN: 文艺复兴拉丁语说 literae humaniores「更有人味的文字」；复数 humanities 保留了这一主张：这些学问使人更像人。

senses.title: Civilized refinement
senses.titleCN: 教养：使人文雅有礼的修养
senses.definition: cultivated courtesy and refinement of manner
senses.definitionCN: 文雅有礼的教养与举止
senses.example: His humanity showed in how he disagreed: always with the other person's reasons stated first.
senses.exampleCN: 他的教养体现在他如何表示异议：总先把对方的理由说清。
senses.why: This is Cicero's original weight: humanitas as the polish that separates a citizen from a brute, closer to education than to emotion.
senses.whyCN: 这是西塞罗原本的分量：humanitas 是使公民区别于野蛮人的修养，更近于教育而非情感。

senses.title: Frailty and mortality
senses.titleCN: 人的脆弱：会错、会老、会死的处境
senses.definition: the weakness and mortality that belong to being a person
senses.definitionCN: 作为人所固有的软弱、易错与必死
senses.example: The film strips the general of his medals and leaves him his humanity.
senses.exampleCN: 影片剥去将军的勋章，只留下他作为人的脆弱。
senses.why: Because humanitas marks what belongs to people, it also marks what people cannot escape; the word can console as easily as it can praise.
senses.whyCN: 因为 humanitas 标记属于人的东西，它也标记人逃不掉的东西；这个词既能称赞，也能安慰。

senses.title: Mercy in practice
senses.titleCN: 实践中的怜悯：战争与灾难中的底线
senses.definition: the minimum of mercy that people owe one another even in conflict
senses.definitionCN: 即便在冲突中也应给人的最低限度的怜悯
senses.example: The laws of humanity forbid leaving the wounded without water.
senses.exampleCN: 人道法则禁止让伤员无水可饮。
senses.why: Law borrowed the word for a floor below which conduct may not fall: humanity is what remains owed when every other claim has been set aside.
senses.whyCN: 法律借用这个词来指行为不可跌破的底线：当其他主张都被搁置时，仍欠人的那一份就是 humanity。

senses.title: A shared moral community
senses.titleCN: 共同的道义共同体：人对人的相互归属
senses.definition: the sense that all people belong to one another and owe one another something
senses.definitionCN: 一切人对彼此都有归属与亏欠的意识
senses.example: The appeal was made in the name of a humanity that includes the enemy.
senses.exampleCN: 这项呼吁以包含敌人的那份人类共同体之名提出。
senses.why: Because humanitas could name the whole race, the collective sense stretches into a moral claim: if the word covers everyone, everyone is inside the circle of obligation, including the enemy.
senses.whyCN: 由于 humanitas 本可指整个族类，集体义便伸展为一种道义主张：既然这个词涵盖所有人，所有人就都在义务圈内，包括敌人。

senses.title: The human side of an institution
senses.titleCN: 机构中的人情一面：制度里的人
senses.definition: the human, personal side of an institution or a system
senses.definitionCN: 机构或制度中属于人的、个人的一面
senses.example: The ward kept its humanity by letting families stay after hours.
senses.exampleCN: 这间病房靠允许家属夜间留下，保住了它的人情。
senses.why: When an institution is said to have lost its humanity, its warmth is being separated from its rules; the collective noun is reused for the quality that rules cannot supply.
senses.whyCN: 当说某机构失去人情时，是把温度从规则里剥离出来；集体名词被借来指规则无法提供的那份品质。

intro.en: Humanity is Cicero's Latin abstract noun, famous as his rendering of a Greek educational ideal; its later split into 'everyone' and 'the better in everyone' happened in English.
intro.cn: humanity 是西塞罗的拉丁抽象名词，以翻译希腊教育理想而著名；后来「所有人」与「人身上最好的部分」两义的分裂发生在英语里。

items.en: Humanus 'human, kind' was the adjective of homo 'person'; both 'belonging to people' and 'good to people' were already inside it.
items.cn: humanus「人的、仁厚的」是 homo「人」的形容词；「属于人」与「善待人的」两义本已在其中。

items.en: Humanitas named human nature, humane feeling and cultivated learning at once; the abstraction was formed with -itas, the ending that makes a quality noun.
items.cn: humanitas 同时指人性、仁厚与教养；这一抽象由 -itas 构成，那是把形容词变成品质名词的词尾。

items.en: Cicero used humanitas for the Greek paideia, the training that makes a person fully human; the pairing is generally accepted, though it is Cicero's choice rather than a literal translation.
items.cn: 西塞罗用 humanitas 对译希腊 paideia，即使人成为完整之人的教养；这一配对一般被接受，但它是西塞罗的选用，而非逐字直译。

items.en: Old French humanite carried the noun into English in the fourteenth century, first in the sense of human nature and kind feeling.
items.cn: 古法语 humanite 在 14 世纪把这个名词带入英语，最初指人性与仁厚之情。

items.en: The collective sense 'all people' is a later English development, and the plural humanities took over the educational sense in the Renaissance.
items.cn: 「全体人」的集体义是英语后来发展出的；复数 humanities 在文艺复兴时期接过了教育义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the origin of homo behind humanus is unsettled, and the humus 'earth' reading is a hypothesis; no pre-Latin form is attested.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：humanus 背后的 homo 来源未定，与 humus「土地」的读法是假说；拉丁语之前的形式无书证。

note.en: Group one holds the same-family words whose senses overlap just enough to be confused; group two holds the collective nouns for people.
note.cn: 第一组是同族词，词义交叠到刚好容易混；第二组是指全体人的集体名词。

entries.definition: The older French-shaped borrowing: compassionate and merciful, with no collective meaning at all.
entries.definitionCN: 较早的法国形状借词：仁慈宽厚，完全没有集体义。

entries.definition: The neutral adjective and the countable noun; it never means people as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 中性形容词与可数名词；从不指全体人。

entries.definition: The outlook that places human values and human learning at the centre; it is a programme, not a feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 把人的价值与学问置于中心的取向；是一套主张，不是一种情感。

entries.definition: The negation of the kind sense: cruelty, the absence of what people owe one another.
entries.definitionCN: 仁厚义的反面：残忍，人不再亏欠彼此。

entries.definition: A gender-neutral collective noun for the species; it carries no evaluative shade.
entries.definitionCN: 指物种的中性集体名词；不带评价色彩。

entries.definition: The traditional collective noun, now often avoided because its second element once meant 'man'.
entries.definitionCN: 传统的集体名词，因第二成分曾指「男人」，今常被回避。

entries.definition: The ordinary word for persons, used with numbers; humanity never takes a number.
entries.definitionCN: 指人的日常词，可与数目连用；humanity 从不用数目。

entries.definition: The organized social life of a large society; it overlaps with the refinement sense but not with the collective one.
entries.definitionCN: 大型社会的有组织生活；与教养义部分重叠，但与总称义无关。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin layers, real derivatives and real fixed phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁层次、真实派生词与真实搭配，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin humanitas packed three things: human nature, kind feeling and cultivated learning; English gave each a separate life.
normal.cn: 拉丁 humanitas 装了三样东西：人性、仁厚与教养；英语让每一义各自生活。

normal.en: The family runs human, humane, humanity, humanities, humanism, humanitarian, inhumanity.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 human、humane、humanity、humanities、humanism、humanitarian、inhumanity。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the collective sense: a crime against humanity, the future of humanity.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出总称义：反人类罪、人类的未来。

normal.en: The plural humanities is a Renaissance inheritance: literae humaniores, the more human letters.
normal.cn: 复数 humanities 是文艺复兴的遗产：literae humaniores，更有人味的文字。

normal.en: Cicero is the hinge: paideia became humanitas, and education became the measure of a person.
normal.cn: 西塞罗是关键：paideia 变成 humanitas，教养成了衡量人的尺度。

abstract.en: Picture a ferry that asks no name and takes everyone aboard.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘不问姓名、把所有人都载上的渡船。

abstract.en: Picture a library where the shelves are labelled with what they make people become.
abstract.cn: 想象一座图书馆，书架标着它们使人成为什么。

abstract.en: Picture a law that keeps one bare promise when every other promise has failed.
abstract.cn: 想象一条法律，在其他承诺都失效时仍守着一个最低承诺。

examples.en: The report treated water as a matter of common humanity, not of charity.
examples.cn: 报告把水视为共同人性之事，而非施舍。

examples.en: Reading history is part of the humanities, and it is also an argument about humanity.
examples.cn: 读历史属于人文学科，同时也是一场关于人性的论证。

examples.en: No institution keeps its humanity by accident; someone has to insist on it.
examples.cn: 没有哪个机构是偶然保住人情的；总得有人坚持。

dict_mnemonic.text: human（人的）+ ity（性质）＝ 人的性质，既指全体人，也指仁厚；记「一个词管两个极端：所有人与最好的人」。

root: 拉丁 humanitas「人性、仁厚、教养」，由 humanus「人的」+ -itas（品质名词词尾）构成；humanus 出自 homo「人」，homo 更深来源不确定，与 humus「土地」的联系仅为假说。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses divide one abstraction into two families: a collective family (all people, a shared moral community, the human side of an institution) and a quality family (kindness, refinement, frailty, mercy, and the studies that claim to cultivate it).
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把同一个抽象分成两族：集体一族（全体人、共同道义体、机构中的人情）与品质一族（仁厚、教养、脆弱、怜悯，以及自称能培养它的那些学问）。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ferry landing after a flood, where nobody asks where anyone is from.
core.cn: 核心意象：洪水后的渡口，没有人问谁从哪里来。

branches.en: EVERYONE AND WHAT EVERYONE IS: the collective, then the nature shared by it.
branches.cn: 所有人，以及所有人共有的东西：先是全体，再是共有的本性。

branches.en: WARMTH AND ITS POLISH: compassion in action, and the courtesy that education adds.
branches.cn: 温度与它的打磨：行动中的怜悯，以及教养添上的礼节。

branches.en: THE STUDIES THAT CLAIM IT: the humanities as the inheritors of paideia.
branches.cn: 自称能培养它的学问：人文学科作为 paideia 的继承者。

branches.en: THE LOW END AND THE FLOOR: frailty that cannot be avoided, and mercy that cannot be withheld.
branches.cn: 低处与底线：无法避免的脆弱，与不可扣留的怜悯。

branches.en: COMMUNITY AND INSTITUTIONS: a bond that includes the enemy, and the warmth rules cannot supply.
branches.cn: 共同体与机构：包含敌人的纽带，以及规则无法提供的温度。

intro.en: Humanity is an abstract noun built on a Latin adjective with a Latin quality ending, and the same stem supports a large family with two competing borrowings.
intro.cn: humanity 是由拉丁形容词加拉丁品质词尾构成的抽象名词，同一词干支撑一大族词，其中有两次相互竞争的借入。

latinIntro.en: Latin homo supplies the stem, humanus the adjective, and -itas the quality noun; English also holds the earlier French-shaped humane beside the later Latin-shaped human.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 homo 提供词干，humanus 提供形容词，-itas 构成品质名词；英语里较早的法国形状 humane 与较晚的拉丁形状 human 并存。

intro.en: Humble forms humility, humbly, and the verb humbled.
intro.cn: humble 可构成 humility、humbly 以及动词形式 humbled。

latinIntro.en: The Latin humus, earth, also hides in exhume and inhume.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 humus（土地）也藏在 exhume 与 inhume 中。

items.example: They were humbled by the welcome.

items.exampleCN: 这是一次令人谦卑的经历。

latinEntries.example: Humilis is the source of humble.
latinEntries.exampleCN: humilis 是 humble 的来源。

definition_zh: 潮湿的；湿润的；闷热的（空气或天气）
definition_en: containing a lot of water vapour; damp and often uncomfortably warm
core_image: 热带雨季的午后，墙壁摸上去发潮，风扇吹来的风也是热的
scene: 热带雨季的午后，墙壁摸上去发潮，风扇吹来的风带着热气。The air felt humid even in the shade of the veranda.
sceneCN: 这里 humid 指「空气含水汽多、潮湿的」（第 1 个义项：空气潮湿的）；句意为即使站在走廊的阴凉处，空气仍然潮湿。图中可辨识物件：潮湿的墙、风扇、走廊阴影、水汽。

senses.title: Damp air
senses.definition: describing air that holds a great deal of water vapour
senses.definitionCN: 形容空气含有大量水汽
senses.example: The air felt humid even in the shade of the veranda.
senses.exampleCN: 即使站在走廊的阴凉处，空气仍然潮湿。
senses.why: Latin humidus simply meant moist, and English kept that plain physical sense first.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 humidus 本义就是潮湿，英语最先保留了这个朴素的物理义。

senses.title: A wet climate
senses.definition: describing a region or season with high moisture and frequent rain
senses.definitionCN: 形容一个地区或季节水汽高、降雨频繁
senses.example: Rice grows well in a humid climate.
senses.exampleCN: 水稻在湿润的气候里长得好。
senses.why: a region's moisture is what makes a climate humid, not a single day.
senses.whyCN: 使气候算得上湿润的是一个地区的水汽，而不是某一天。

senses.title: Oppressively warm and damp
senses.definition: describing warmth made worse by moisture, so that the body cannot cool
senses.definitionCN: 形容潮湿使炎热更难忍受，身体无法散热
senses.example: The humid heat kept everyone indoors at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 湿热的暑气让正午时人人都待在室内。
senses.why: moisture slows evaporation, and the word absorbed that discomfort.
senses.whyCN: 水汽减慢蒸发，这个词就吸收了这种不适。

senses.title: A moist air mass
senses.titleCN: 气象学上含大量水汽的气团
senses.definition: technical: describing an air mass whose vapour content is high
senses.definitionCN: 技术用法：形容水汽含量高的气团
senses.example: A humid air mass from the sea met a cold front inland.
senses.exampleCN: 来自海上的湿气团在内陆遇上冷锋。
senses.why: meteorology needs a label for vapour-rich air, and the adjective serves it.
senses.whyCN: 气象学需要给富含水汽的空气一个标签，这个形容词就服务于此。

senses.title: A damp room
senses.definition: describing a room, wall or building that feels or stays wet
senses.definitionCN: 形容房间、墙壁或建筑摸上去或一直是湿的
senses.example: The humid cellar smelled of old stone.
senses.exampleCN: 潮湿的地窖散发着旧石头的味道。
senses.why: a room that stays wet earns the adjective just as air does.
senses.whyCN: 一直湿着的房间也像空气一样配得上这个形容词。

senses.title: A moist habitat
senses.definition: describing an environment wet enough for moisture-loving plants and animals
senses.definitionCN: 形容环境足够湿润，适合喜湿的动植物
senses.example: Ferns cover the humid slopes above the stream.
senses.exampleCN: 蕨类铺满溪流上方湿润的坡地。
senses.why: plants that need moisture mark their habitats with the word.
senses.whyCN: 需要水汽的植物用这个词来标记它们的栖息地。

senses.title: Causing dampness
senses.definition: describing conditions that make objects, clothes or food damp
senses.definitionCN: 形容使物品、衣物或食物受潮的状况
senses.example: The humid weather left the salt in lumps.
senses.exampleCN: 潮湿的天气让盐结成了块。
senses.why: if the air will not take more water, objects keep the damp.
senses.whyCN: 如果空气不再收水，物品就把潮湿留住。

senses.title: The feel of a wet season
senses.definition: describing the characteristic air of a rainy season
senses.definitionCN: 形容雨季特有的空气感
senses.example: Everything in the humid season dries slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 雨季里什么东西都干得慢。
senses.why: a whole season can have a character, and the adjective names it.
senses.whyCN: 整个季节也能有一种性格，这个形容词为它命名。

intro.en: Humid comes from Latin humidus 'moist', an adjective from humere 'to be moist'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: humid 来自拉丁 humidus「潮湿的」，它是 humere「潮湿」的形容词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Humere meant 'to be moist' or 'to be wet'. Its deeper origin is not established; the Indo-European root often cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: humere 意为「潮湿、湿」。其更深来源未得到证明，常为它引用的印欧词根属重构形式。

items.en: Humidus 'moist, wet' was formed from humere and existed beside the variant umidus.
items.cn: humidus「潮湿的」由 humere 构成，并与变体 umidus 并存。

items.en: English humid appears in the sixteenth century, borrowed through French, and first described damp air and damp ground.
items.cn: 英语 humid 在十六世纪出现，经法语借入，最初描述潮湿的空气与地面。

items.en: The word settled into weather description, especially for warm air full of vapour.
items.cn: 这个词稳定用于天气描写，尤指饱含水汽的暖空气。

items.en: Meteorology uses it for air masses with high vapour content, and the noun humidity carries the measured value.
items.cn: 气象学用它形容水汽含量高的气团，名词 humidity 则承载测得的数值。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin): the pre-Latin source of humere is not established, and its first English date is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源）：humere 在拉丁语之前的来源未得到证明，它在英语中的首见年代也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like humid but come from other roots; group two holds adjectives for wetness and sticky heat.
note.cn: 第一组是外形像 humid、却来自其他词根的词；第二组是表示潮湿与湿热黏腻的形容词。

entries.definition: From Latin humilis 'low' and humus 'earth': modesty. It shares letters with humid but not a root.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 humilis「低微的」与 humus「土地」：谦逊。它与 humid 共享字母，却不共词根。

entries.definition: Organic matter in soil, from Latin humus; it is solid earth, not moist air.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中的有机质，来自拉丁 humus；它是固体泥土，不是潮湿空气。

entries.definition: To make the air moist; it is an action, while humid is a state.
entries.definitionCN: 使空气潮湿；它是动作，而 humid 是状态。

entries.definition: Relating to the four bodily humours of old medicine; the root is humor 'fluid', not humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 与旧医学的四种体液有关；词根是 humor「液体」，不是湿度。

entries.definition: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way; humidusually describes air rather than a surface.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微潮湿，常带不快意味；humid 通常描述空气，而非表面。

entries.definition: Slightly wet in a neutral or pleasant way, as cake or eyes; humid is about air.
entries.definitionCN: 中性或宜人的轻微湿润，如蛋糕或眼睛；humid 讲的是空气。

entries.definition: Unpleasantly warm and damp, used of weather; it adds heat to humidity's moisture.
entries.definitionCN: 令人不适的湿热天气；在 humidity 的水汽之上加了热。

entries.definition: Describing air or a surface that feels adhesive because of moisture; it is the body's impression.
entries.definitionCN: 形容空气或表面因水汽而黏手；是身体的感受。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin humere 'to be moist' gives humid, humidity, humidify.
normal.cn: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」给出 humid、humidity、humidify。

normal.en: The family runs humid, humidity, humidly, humidness, dehumidify.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 humid、humidity、humidly、humidness、dehumidify。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: humid air, humid climate, hot and humid.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：潮湿的空气、湿润的气候、又热又潮。

normal.en: The trap is humility, from humus 'earth', meaning modesty.
normal.cn: 陷阱是 humility，出自 humus「土地」，意为谦逊。

normal.en: Humid is about air; damp and moist usually describe surfaces.
normal.cn: humid 讲空气；damp 与 moist 通常描述表面。

abstract.en: Picture a wall you touch and find wet in the afternoon.
abstract.cn: 想象午后摸一面墙，手上是湿的。

abstract.en: Picture a fan pushing warm air that never cools the skin.
abstract.cn: 想象风扇吹着暖风，皮肤却始终不凉。

abstract.en: Picture salt in a bowl slowly turning into lumps.
abstract.cn: 想象碗里的盐慢慢结成块。

examples.en: The humid air made the laundry take two days to dry.
examples.cn: 潮湿的空气让洗好的衣物两天才干。

examples.en: Summers here are hot and humid.
examples.cn: 这里的夏天又热又潮湿。

examples.en: Mould grows quickly in humid cellars.
examples.cn: 霉菌在潮湿的地窖里长得很快。

dict_mnemonic.text: humid 就是「潮湿的」，名词是 humidity（湿度）：空气里水汽多，摸上去湿、身上又闷

root: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」→ humidus「潮湿的」→ 经法语进入英语 humid；更深印欧词根属重构形式，来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one kind of air: damp air, a wet climate, oppressive warmth, a moist air mass, a damp room, a wet habitat, conditions that make things damp and the feel of a rainy season.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种空气展开：潮湿的空气、湿润的气候、闷热难当、潮湿气团、潮湿地窖、湿润栖息地、使物受潮的天气，以及雨季的湿气感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall that feels wet under the palm in the afternoon.
core.cn: 核心意象：午后掌心按上去发热发湿的一面墙。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL AIR: damp air on the skin and a moist air mass on a map.
branches.cn: 物理的空气：皮肤上的潮湿空气与图上的湿气团。

branches.en: THE WET SEASON: climate, oppressive heat and the feel of the rains belong together.
branches.cn: 雨季：气候、湿热与雨季的体感属于一体。

branches.en: THE ROOM: a cellar stays wet because the air will not take the water.
branches.cn: 房间：地窖一直湿着，因为空气不肯收水。

branches.en: THE HABITAT: ferns mark the slopes where moisture stays.
branches.cn: 栖息地：蕨类标记出水汽停留的坡地。

branches.en: THE CONSEQUENCE: salt lumps and laundry hangs in the same weather.
branches.cn: 后果：同一场天气里盐结块、衣物晾不干。

intro.en: Humid is a Latin adjective whose root also builds the noun for the measured quantity and the verbs for adding or removing moisture.
intro.cn: humid 是一个拉丁形容词，其词根还构成表示可测数量的名词，以及加湿与除湿的动词。

latinIntro.en: Latin humere and humidus supply the core; English adds -ity for the noun and the prefix de- for removal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 humere 与 humidus 提供核心；英语加 -ity 构成名词，加前缀 de- 表示去除。

items.meaning: the amount of vapour in the air

items.example: Humidness is hard to measure by feel.
items.exampleCN: 潮湿的程度很难靠感觉测量。
这台设备为育婴室加湿。

items.example: The hygrometer read ninety per cent.

latinEntries.structure: humidus, humida, humidum (adj., first and second declension)

definition_zh: 湿度；空气中水汽的含量；（常指）相对湿度
definition_en: the amount of water vapour in the air, usually reported as relative humidity
core_image: 一块湿布挂在封闭房间里，窗玻璃上凝着一层细小的水珠
scene: 梅雨季的午后，墙上挂着的毛巾一直不干，窗玻璃蒙着一层水汽。Humidity in the valley stayed above ninety per cent for a week.
sceneCN: 这里 humidity 指「空气中水汽的含量」（第 1 个义项：湿度总称）；句意为这个山谷的湿度连续一周超过九成。图中可辨识物件：湿毛巾、蒙雾的窗玻璃、水珠、温度计。

pos.zh: 相对湿度（天气报告中常省略「相对」）

forms.label: 复数（不同环境的湿度值）

senses.title: Water vapour in the air
senses.definition: the amount of water vapour present in the air
senses.definitionCN: 空气中水汽的含量
senses.example: Humidity in the valley stayed above ninety per cent for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这个山谷的湿度连续一周超过九成。
senses.why: Latin humiditas named moistness, and meteorology narrowed it to vapour in the air.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁 humiditas 本指潮湿，气象学把它收窄为空气中的水汽。

senses.title: Relative humidity
senses.definition: the ratio of actual vapour to the maximum the air could hold at that temperature
senses.definitionCN: 实际水汽与该温度下空气所能容纳最大水汽的比值
senses.example: At thirty degrees, a relative humidity of eighty per cent feels far hotter.
senses.exampleCN: 在三十度时，八成相对湿度让人感觉热得多。
senses.why: weather reports need a ratio that people can feel, so the relative form became the default.
senses.whyCN: 天气报告需要一个能被人感受到的比值，相对湿度因此成了默认说法。

senses.title: Absolute humidity
senses.definition: the mass of water vapour in a given volume of air
senses.definitionCN: 一定体积空气中所含水汽的质量
senses.example: Absolute humidity is measured in grams per cubic metre.
senses.exampleCN: 绝对湿度以每立方米克数计量。
senses.why: engineering needs an amount rather than a ratio, so the absolute form is named separately.
senses.whyCN: 工程需要的是量而非比值，绝对湿度因此单独命名。

senses.title: Specific humidity
senses.definition: the mass of vapour per unit mass of moist air
senses.definitionCN: 每单位质量湿空气中所含水汽的质量
senses.example: Specific humidity changes little when air rises and cools.
senses.exampleCN: 空气上升冷却时，比湿变化很小。
senses.why: meteorology prefers a measure that survives compression and expansion, hence the per-mass form.
senses.whyCN: 气象学偏爱一种在压缩与膨胀中仍稳定的量，于是有了按质量计的形式。

senses.title: Humidity as a felt quality
senses.definition: the uncomfortable dampness felt when the air is warm and full of vapour
senses.definitionCN: 空气温暖且饱含水汽时令人不适的潮湿感
senses.example: The humidity made the whole afternoon feel sticky.
senses.exampleCN: 这种湿度让整个下午都黏糊糊的。
senses.why: the measured quantity also has a felt side, and everyday speech uses the word for that.
senses.whyCN: 这个可测的量也有体感的一面，日常语言就用这个词来指那种感觉。

senses.title: A figure in a weather report
senses.titleCN: 天气报告中的湿度指标
senses.definition: the percentage or value reported alongside temperature in a forecast
senses.definitionCN: 预报中与温度并列报告的那个百分数或数值
senses.example: The forecast gave thirty-two degrees and high humidity.
senses.exampleCN: 预报给出三十二度与高湿度。
senses.why: a forecast needs a compact number, and humidity became one of its standard figures.
senses.whyCN: 预报需要一个紧凑的数字，湿度成了它的标准数值之一。

senses.title: A controlled target indoors
senses.definition: the humidity level maintained in a greenhouse, museum, hospital or home
senses.definitionCN: 温室、博物馆、医院或住宅中维持的湿度水平
senses.example: The archive keeps humidity steady to protect the paper.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆保持湿度稳定以保护纸张。
senses.why: materials need a narrow band of moisture, so buildings and museums control the value.
senses.whyCN: 材料需要一个很窄的水汽区间，建筑与博物馆因此控制这个数值。

senses.title: Effects on materials and health
senses.titleCN: 湿度对材料与健康的影响
senses.definition: the practical effects of moisture on wood, metal, lungs and skin
senses.definitionCN: 水汽对木材、金属、肺与皮肤的实际影响
senses.example: High humidity warped the floorboards within a season.
senses.exampleCN: 高湿度在一个季度内就让地板变形。
senses.why: the quantity has consequences, and the word extends to those consequences in building and health science.
senses.whyCN: 这个量有后果，这个词就延伸到建筑与健康科学中的这些后果。

intro.en: Humidity comes from Latin humiditas, a noun from humidus 'moist', itself from humere 'to be moist'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: humidity 来自拉丁 humiditas，它是 humidus「潮湿的」的名词形式，而 humidus 出自 humere「潮湿」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Humere meant 'to be moist'. Its deeper origin is not established, and the Indo-European root often cited for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: humere 意为「潮湿」。其更深来源未得到证明，常为它引用的印欧词根属于重构形式。

items.en: Humidus 'moist, wet' was the adjective from humere; it existed beside a variant umidus.
items.cn: humidus「潮湿的」是由 humere 构成的形容词，并与变体 umidus 并存。

items.en: Humiditas 'moistness' added the noun suffix to humidus and named the quality rather than a thing.
items.cn: humiditas「潮湿」在 humidus 上加名词后缀，指性质而非具体事物。

items.en: English humidity appears in the sixteenth century, borrowed through French from the Latin noun, and first meant dampness in general.
items.cn: 英语 humidity 在十六世纪出现，经法语从拉丁名词借入，最初泛指潮湿。

items.en: From the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries humidity became a measured quantity of vapour in the air, with relative and absolute forms.
items.cn: 从十八、十九世纪起，humidity 成为空气中水汽的可测数量，并有相对与绝对两种形式。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin and first date): the pre-Latin source of humere is not established, and the first English date is usually given as the 1530s but is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词源与首见年代）：humere 在拉丁语之前的来源未得到证明；英语首见通常定为十六世纪三十年代，但只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds words that resemble humidity but belong to other roots; group two holds words for moisture itself.
note.cn: 第一组是外形像 humidity、却属于其他词根的词；第二组是表示潮湿本身的词。

entries.definition: From Latin humilis 'low, humble', from humus 'earth': the quality of being humble. The resemblance to humidity is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 来自拉丁 humilis「低微的、谦卑的」，源于 humus「土地」：谦逊的品质。与 humidity 相似纯属偶然。

entries.definition: Dark organic matter in soil, from Latin humus 'earth'; it is a solid, not water vapour.
entries.definitionCN: 土壤中的深色有机质，来自拉丁 humus「土地」；它是固体，不是水汽。

entries.definition: To add water vapour to the air; it acts on air rather than naming the amount in it.
entries.definitionCN: 向空气加入水汽；作用于空气，而非指其中的数量。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning damp; humidity is the noun for the quantity or quality.
entries.definitionCN: 表示潮湿的形容词；humidity 是表示数量或性质的名词。

entries.definition: Water present in small amounts in air or a material; it names the water, while humidity names the amount in air.
entries.definitionCN: 空气或材料中少量存在的水；它指水本身，humidity 指空气中的含量。

entries.definition: The unpleasant quality of being slightly wet; it is closer to the felt side of humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 轻微潮湿的令人不适的性质；更接近 humidity 的体感一面。

entries.definition: Warm, humid air that feels oppressive; it combines heat with humidity.
entries.definitionCN: 闷热潮湿、令人压抑的空气；把热与湿度合在一起。

entries.definition: Water in its gaseous state; humidity is the measure of how much of it the air holds.
entries.definitionCN: 气态的水；humidity 是空气含有多少这种水的度量。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real word parts, real fixed phrases and real word relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Latin humere 'to be moist' gives humid, humidity, humidify.
normal.cn: 拉丁 humere「潮湿」给出 humid、humidity、humidify。

definition_en: a violent tropical storm with extremely strong winds, especially one formed over the North Atlantic
core_image: 海面被风撕成白色的水墙，棕榈树几乎贴地，天空是一整片旋转的铅灰色云盘
scene: 海边小镇的广播响起，居民正用木板封住窗户，说 A hurricane is expected to make landfall before midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 hurricane 指「在北大西洋形成的强热带气旋」（第 1 个义项：中心气压极低、风速极大的热带风暴系统）；句意为预计飓风将在午夜前登陆。图中可辨识物件：封窗木板、棕榈树、铅灰色云墙、收音机。

pos.zh: 飓风；强热带气旋（可数，复数 hurricanes）
比喻猛烈的事件风波（如政治飓风）

senses.title: A North Atlantic tropical cyclone
senses.titleCN: 北大西洋的强热带气旋
senses.definition: a tropical cyclone with sustained winds of at least seventy-four miles per hour, formed over the North Atlantic or the eastern Pacific
senses.definitionCN: 在北大西洋或东太平洋形成、持续风速至少每小时七十四英里的热带气旋
senses.example: The hurricane gathered strength over the warm ocean before turning north.
senses.exampleCN: 飓风在温暖的洋面上积蓄力量，然后转向北方。
senses.why: The word names a regional kind of storm, so its defining feature is where it forms as much as how hard it blows.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指一种区域性风暴，因此其定义特征既在风力，也在形成海域。

senses.title: Wind of extreme force
senses.definition: wind strong enough to be classed at hurricane force on the Beaufort scale, regardless of the storm system
senses.definitionCN: 在蒲福风级上达到飓风级的强风，不论其属于哪个风暴系统
senses.example: The gusts reached hurricane force on the exposed headland.
senses.exampleCN: 在无遮蔽的岬角上，阵风达到了飓风级。
senses.why: Sailors used the word for the wind before meteorologists used it for the storm, so the force sense survives on its own.
senses.whyCN: 水手先把这个词用于风，气象学家后才用于风暴，因此「风力」义独立存在。

senses.title: The hurricane season
senses.definition: the annual period, usually June to November in the Atlantic, when such storms are most likely
senses.definitionCN: 这类风暴最可能发生的年度时段，大西洋通常为六月至十一月
senses.example: Insurance rates rise when the hurricane season begins.
senses.exampleCN: 飓风季开始时，保险费率会上涨。
senses.why: Seasonal planning turned the storm name into a calendar term, with its own fixed collocations.
senses.whyCN: 季节性规划把风暴之名变成日历术语，并固定了搭配。

senses.title: The eye and the eyewall
senses.definition: the calm clear centre of the storm and the ring of violent winds immediately around it
senses.definitionCN: 风暴中心平静晴朗的区域及其周围一圈猛烈风带
senses.example: The eye of the hurricane passed directly over the island.
senses.exampleCN: 飓风眼正好从岛上经过。
senses.why: The structure is so distinctive that the storm's own anatomy is discussed using the same word.
senses.whyCN: 这一结构太有辨识度，人们讨论风暴自身的解剖结构时也用同一个词。

senses.title: A category on the Saffir-Simpson scale
senses.definition: one of five numbered categories that rate a hurricane by its sustained wind speed and expected damage
senses.definitionCN: 按持续风速与预期破坏程度把飓风分为五级中的某一级
senses.example: The storm was upgraded to a category four hurricane overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 这场风暴一夜之间被升为四级飓风。
senses.why: Forecasters needed a compact severity scale, and the storm word supplies the unit being graded.
senses.whyCN: 预报员需要一个简洁的强度标尺，而风暴之名提供了被分级的单位。

senses.title: A warning to evacuate
senses.definition: an official alert that a hurricane is expected in a named area within a set time, often triggering evacuation
senses.definitionCN: 官方通告某地在规定时间内将遭遇飓风，常引发疏散
senses.example: The hurricane warning sent thousands to higher ground.
senses.exampleCN: 飓风警报让数千人撤往高处。
senses.why: Emergency management names the alert after the hazard, so the warning is simply 'the hurricane' in official speech.
senses.whyCN: 应急管理按危险源给警报命名，因此在官方话语里警报就叫「飓风」。

senses.title: A figurative storm of events
senses.definition: a violent upheaval of criticism, change or emotion that sweeps through an organization or a life
senses.definitionCN: 批评、变化或情绪在组织或人生中横扫而过的猛烈动荡
senses.example: A hurricane of protest followed the announcement.
senses.exampleCN: 公告之后掀起了一场抗议飓风。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the storm's shape: something huge arrives fast, spins everything and leaves damage behind.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了风暴的形状：巨大的东西快速到来，把一切卷起，再留下破坏。

senses.title: A hurricane lamp
senses.definition: a lamp with a protected flame or bulb that keeps burning in strong wind
senses.definitionCN: 带防护罩、能在强风中继续燃烧或发光的灯
senses.example: They lit a hurricane lamp when the power failed.
senses.exampleCN: 停电时他们点起一盏防风灯。
senses.why: The lamp is named for the wind it resists, so 'hurricane' here describes a protection standard rather than a storm.
senses.whyCN: 这种灯因能抗风而得名，因此这里的 hurricane 描述的是防护标准，而不是风暴。

intro.en: Hurricane came into English through Spanish huracán, and the usual account traces it to a Caribbean word recorded as hurakán. The deeper origin is debated, so the safest statement is that the Caribbean source is generally accepted while the pre-Columbian root remains uncertain.
intro.cn: hurricane 经西班牙语 huracán 进入英语，通常的说法把它上溯到一个加勒比词语 hurakán。更深的来源仍有争议，因此最稳妥的表述是：加勒比来源一般认为是可靠的，而哥伦布时期之前的词根仍不确定。

items.en: Sources record a Carib or Taino word hurakán for a violent storm; it is generally accepted as the origin, though the spelling and the exact language vary between accounts.
items.cn: 文献记录了一个加勒比或泰诺语词 hurakán，意为猛烈风暴；一般认为它就是来源，但各家记载的拼写与具体语言并不一致。

items.en: Spanish sailors adopted the Caribbean word as huracán and used it for the storms they met in the Caribbean Sea.
items.cn: 西班牙水手把这个加勒比词采纳为 huracán，用来指他们在加勒比海遇到的风暴。

items.en: English borrowed the Spanish form in the sixteenth century, first in travel and navigation writing.
items.cn: 英语在 16 世纪借入西班牙语形式，最早见于旅行与航海文献。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the word was fixed to tropical cyclones of the North Atlantic, giving it a precise regional meaning.
items.cn: 在 19 与 20 世纪，这个词被固定指北大西洋的热带气旋，获得了精确的区域含义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the pre-Columbian origin cannot be reconstructed with confidence, and other proposals exist; they should be listed as hypotheses, not chosen as fact.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：哥伦布时期之前的来源无法可靠重构，另有其他假说；这些只应并列，不应择一定为事实。

note.en: Group one holds phrases built on the word hurricane that are not the storm itself; group two holds other storm names and wind words that are constantly confused with it.
note.cn: 第一组是由 hurricane 构成、但并不指风暴本身的短语；第二组是常与它混淆的其他风暴名与风类词。

entries.definition: A lamp built to keep burning in strong wind; the word describes its protection, not a weather system.
entries.definitionCN: 为在强风中持续燃烧而造的灯；这里的词描述防护性能，而非天气系统。

entries.definition: An adjective for winds of Beaufort twelve or above, which may occur without any tropical storm.
entries.definitionCN: 形容蒲福十二级以上的风，这种风可以在没有热带风暴时出现。

entries.definition: The yearly window when such storms are likely; it is a period, not a single event.
entries.definitionCN: 这类风暴可能发生的年度时段；它是一段时间，不是单次事件。

entries.definition: A formal notice that hurricane conditions are expected; the warning is not the storm.
entries.definitionCN: 预告将出现飓风条件的正式通告；警报并不是风暴本身。

entries.definition: The same kind of tropical cyclone, but the name used in the western North Pacific; region, not strength, separates it from hurricane.
entries.definitionCN: 同类的热带气旋，但用于西北太平洋；区别在海域而非强度。

entries.definition: The general meteorological term for any rotating low-pressure system, including hurricanes and typhoons.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何旋转低压系统的通用气象术语，包括飓风与台风。

entries.definition: A much smaller, short-lived vortex formed over land, not a vast tropical storm.
entries.definitionCN: 在陆地上形成的规模小得多、寿命很短的涡旋，不是庞大的热带风暴。

entries.definition: A very strong wind, graded on the Beaufort scale, with no organised storm structure.
entries.definitionCN: 极强的风，按蒲福风级划分，没有组织化的风暴结构。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real borrowing path, real storm collocations and real compounds, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的借词路径、真实风暴搭配与真实复合词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Spanish huracán from a Caribbean word hurakán; the borrowing path is the memory hook.
normal.cn: 西班牙语 huracán 来自加勒比词 hurakán；借词路径就是记忆钩子。

normal.en: Region decides the name: hurricane in the Atlantic, typhoon in the western Pacific, cyclone as the general term.
normal.cn: 海域决定名称：大西洋叫飓风，西北太平洋叫台风，气旋是通称。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the season: hurricane season, hurricane warning, hurricane watch.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出季节：飓风季、飓风警报、飓风观察预警。

normal.en: The structure has its own vocabulary: eye, eyewall, storm surge.
normal.cn: 风暴结构有自己的词汇：风眼、眼墙、风暴潮。

normal.en: A hurricane lamp is named for the wind it resists, not for a storm it contains.
normal.cn: 防风灯因能抗风而得名，而不是因为它装着风暴。

abstract.en: Picture a city-sized wheel of cloud turning over a warm sea.
abstract.cn: 想象一个城市大小的云轮在温暖海面上旋转。

abstract.en: Picture a single calm room at the centre of a roaring building.
abstract.cn: 想象一座轰响建筑的中心，有一间安静的房间。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour that arrives like weather and leaves roofs torn open.
abstract.cn: 想象一则像天气一样到来的谣言，走后留下掀开的屋顶。

examples.en: The hurricane destroyed the pier and flooded the lower streets.
examples.cn: 飓风摧毁了码头，淹没了低处的街道。

examples.en: Forecasters tracked the hurricane for five days before it turned.
examples.cn: 预报员追踪这场飓风五天之后它才转向。

examples.en: A hurricane of criticism followed the budget announcement.
examples.cn: 预算公告之后掀起了一阵批评的飓风。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「哈瑞肯」——一个叫哈瑞的名字被狂风卷上了天，就成了飓风

root: 经西班牙语 huracán 借入英语，一般认为是加勒比（泰诺或加勒比语）词 hurakán「猛烈风暴」；更早词根无法可靠重构，另有其他假说，只宜并列而不选定论。该词无拉丁语同族来源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one line: a Caribbean storm word becomes a North Atlantic cyclone, then its wind grade, its season, its anatomy, its severity scale, its warning, its figurative storm and finally an object named for the wind it resists.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一条线索展开：一个加勒比风暴词先成为北大西洋气旋，再成为风力等级、季节、结构、强度分级、警报、比喻风波，最后变成一个以抗风命名的物件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall of white water and palms bent almost flat under a lead-grey sky.
core.cn: 核心意象：白色水墙、几乎贴地的棕榈，以及铅灰色的天空。

branches.en: STORM AND WIND: the name covers both the whole system and its strongest air.
branches.cn: 风暴与风：这个名字既指整个系统，也指它最强的空气。

branches.en: SEASON AND STRUCTURE: planners watch the calendar, meteorologists watch the eye.
branches.cn: 季节与结构：规划者看日历，气象学家看风眼。

branches.en: SCALE AND WARNING: a number grades the storm, and an alert moves people.
branches.cn: 分级与警报：数字给风暴定级，警报把人撤走。

branches.en: SOCIAL STORM: the same shape is borrowed for violent public reaction.
branches.cn: 社会风暴：同样的形状被借去形容激烈的公众反应。

branches.en: THE LAMP: a protected flame is named for the wind it survives.
branches.cn: 防风灯：受保护的火焰以它能扛住的风命名。

intro.en: Hurricane is a borrowed whole word, so it has no Latin prefix or suffix to split; its family is built by compounding with nouns such as season, lamp and warning.
intro.cn: hurricane 是整体借入的词，没有可拆的拉丁前缀或后缀；它的词族靠与 season、lamp、warning 等名词复合而成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source or Latin cognate for this Caribbean borrowing, so no Latin entries are listed; Latin tempestas is only a semantic equivalent.
latinIntro.cn: 这个加勒比借词没有拉丁语来源，也没有拉丁同族词，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语 tempestas 只是语义对应词。

items.example: Two hurricanes formed in one week.
items.exampleCN: 一周内形成了两场飓风。
飓风级阵风使大桥关闭。

items.meaning: a lamp that resists strong wind
items.example: The hurricane lamp burned all night.
The islands prepare before hurricane season.
items.exampleCN: 群岛在飓风季前做好准备。

items.meaning: an official alert of expected hurricane conditions
items.meaningCN: 预告将出现飓风条件的官方警报
items.example: The hurricane warning covered three counties.
items.exampleCN: 飓风警报覆盖了三个县。

items.meaning: the calm centre of the storm
items.example: The wind dropped inside the hurricane eye.

items.meaning: an aircraft that flies into storms to collect data
items.meaningCN: 飞入风暴采集数据的飞机
items.example: A hurricane hunter measured the central pressure.
items.exampleCN: 一架飓风追踪飞机测量了中心气压。

definition_zh: 小屋；棚屋
definition_en: a small simple building, often made of wood
core_image: 田边一间木屋，屋顶压着石块
scene: 农夫在田边搭了一间小屋。The farmer built a hut at the edge of the field.
sceneCN: 这里 hut 是「小屋」（第 1 个义项）；句意：农夫在田边搭了一间小屋。

senses.title: A small simple house
senses.definition: a small building with few rooms
senses.definitionCN: 房间很少的小建筑
senses.example: The farmer built a hut at the edge of the field.
senses.exampleCN: 农夫在田边搭了一间小屋。
senses.why: This is the basic sense of a simple shelter.
senses.whyCN: 这是简易住所的基本义项。

senses.title: A temporary shelter
senses.definition: a rough shelter used for a short time
senses.definitionCN: 短期使用的简陋遮蔽处
senses.example: Workers slept in huts near the road.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们睡在路边的棚屋里。
senses.why: Here the hut is temporary rather than a home.
senses.whyCN: 这里指临时而非长期住所。

intro.en: Hut came through French from an old Germanic word for a shelter.
intro.cn: hut 经法语来自一个表示遮蔽处的古老日耳曼词。

items.en: Hutta meant a small shelter.
items.cn: hutta 意为小遮蔽处。

items.en: Hutte meant a cabin or shed.
items.cn: hutte 意为小屋或棚子。

items.en: Hutte meant a simple dwelling.
items.cn: hutte 意为简陋住所。

items.en: Hut meant a small wooden building.
items.cn: hut 意为小木屋。

items.en: Hut today also names beach shelters.
items.cn: hut 今天也指海滩遮棚。

note.en: Hut is compared with look-alike words and with words for small buildings.
note.cn: 把 hut 与形近词以及表示小型建筑的词作比较。

entries.definition: having a high temperature

definition_zh: 杂种；杂交后代；混合体；混合动力的；混合词
definition_en: an offspring of two different species or varieties, or something made by combining different elements
core_image: 两株不同品种的果树之间长出一棵新树，果实兼具两种风味
scene: 果园里两行不同品种的苹果树之间种了一排新树。园主介绍：This hybrid combines the sweetness of one parent with the hardiness of the other.
sceneCN: 这里指「杂交后代」（第 1 个义项：两个不同物种或品种交配产生的后代）；句意为这个杂交后代兼具一个亲本的甜味与另一个亲本的耐寒性。

pos.zh: 杂种；杂交后代；混合体（可数，复数 hybrids）
杂交的；混合的；混合动力的

forms.label: 复合形容词（混合动力的）

senses.title: An offspring of two kinds
senses.definition: the offspring of two different species or varieties
senses.definitionCN: 两个不同物种或品种交配产生的后代
senses.example: This hybrid combines the sweetness of one parent with the hardiness of the other.
senses.exampleCN: 这个杂交后代兼具一个亲本的甜味与另一个亲本的耐寒性。
senses.why: Hybrid names the product of a cross: two lineages meet, and the offspring carries material from both.
senses.whyCN: hybrid 命名一次杂交的产物：两个世系相遇，后代同时携带双方的材料。

senses.title: A bred hybrid variety
senses.definition: a variety deliberately produced by crossing selected parents
senses.definitionCN: 通过选配亲本有意培育出的品种
senses.example: Farmers planted a hybrid that resists two common diseases.
senses.exampleCN: 农民种了一个能抗两种常见病的杂交品种。
senses.why: Once breeders repeat a cross, the offspring becomes a named product, and the word moves from a single plant to a commercial variety.
senses.whyCN: 一旦育种者重复同一杂交，后代就成了有名称的产品，这个词也从单株植物转指商业品种。

senses.title: A genetically mixed individual
senses.definition: an individual carrying alleles from two distinct gene pools
senses.definitionCN: 携带来自两个不同基因库的等位基因的个体
senses.example: The hybrid carries one allele from each parent species.
senses.exampleCN: 这个杂合个体从每个亲本物种各携带一个等位基因。
senses.why: Genetics makes the crossing precise: the individual is mixed at the level of alleles, not just in appearance.
senses.whyCN: 遗传学把杂交说得更精确：个体在等位基因层面就是混合的，而不只是外观混合。

senses.title: A general mixture
senses.definition: anything made by combining two different things
senses.definitionCN: 由两种不同事物组合而成的任何东西
senses.example: The festival is a hybrid of a concert and a street market.
senses.exampleCN: 这个节庆是音乐会和街市的混合体。
senses.why: The biological picture of two parents producing one offspring is borrowed for any combination of two sources.
senses.whyCN: 两个亲本产生一个后代的生物图像，被借用来形容任何两个来源的组合。

senses.title: A hybrid vehicle
senses.definition: a vehicle powered by two different energy sources, usually an engine and a battery
senses.definitionCN: 由两种能源驱动的车辆，通常是发动机与电池
senses.example: The hybrid uses less fuel in city traffic.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆混合动力车在城市交通中更省油。
senses.why: Engineering keeps the same structure: two power sources are combined in one machine.
senses.whyCN: 工程保留了同一结构：两种动力源被组合进同一台机器。

senses.title: A combined technical system
senses.definition: a system or method that combines two approaches
senses.definitionCN: 把两种方法组合起来的系统或方案
senses.example: The lab adopted a hybrid of field surveys and remote sensing.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室采用了野外调查与遥感的混合方案。
senses.why: When two methods each cover part of a problem, joining them produces a hybrid method.
senses.whyCN: 当两种方法各自覆盖问题的一部分，把它们接起来就产生混合方法。

senses.title: A hybrid word
senses.definition: a word made of elements from different languages
senses.definitionCN: 由不同语言的成分构成的词
senses.example: The term is a hybrid of a Greek root and a Latin suffix.
senses.exampleCN: 这个术语是希腊词根与拉丁后缀的混合词。
senses.why: Language contact mixes material the way breeding mixes lineages, so linguists borrow the biological word.
senses.whyCN: 语言接触混合材料，正如繁育混合世系，因此语言学家借用了这个生物词。

senses.title: A mixed culture or style
senses.definition: a culture, style or identity formed from two different traditions
senses.definitionCN: 由两种不同传统形成的文化、风格或身份
senses.example: The neighborhood has a hybrid cuisine all its own.
senses.exampleCN: 这个街区有自己独特的混合菜系。
senses.why: The word now describes cultural blending, where two traditions meet and produce something neither one alone could make.
senses.whyCN: 这个词现在描述文化混合：两种传统相遇，产生任何一方单独都无法做出的东西。

intro.en: Hybrid comes from Latin hybrida, a word for the offspring of two different kinds, also applied to a person of mixed parentage. Its deeper origin is disputed. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hybrid 来自拉丁 hybrida，指两个不同种类的后代，也用于混合血统的人。它的更深来源有争议。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hybrida named the offspring of a tame sow and a wild boar, and by extension a person of mixed parentage. The word already carried both the animal and the social sense.
items.cn: hybrida 指家猪与野猪的后代，也引申指混合血统的人。这个词从一开始就同时带有动物义与社会义。

items.en: One common account links hybrida to Greek hybris 'insolence, violence, wantonness', but the connection is not established; other explanations have been proposed.
items.cn: 一种常见说法把 hybrida 与希腊 hybris「傲慢、暴烈、放纵」联系起来，但这一联系并未确立，另有其他解释。

items.en: Hybrid entered English in the sixteenth century as a term for a mongrel or a person of mixed descent, then spread to plants and animals.
items.cn: hybrid 在 16 世纪进入英语，指杂种或混合血统的人，随后扩展到植物与动物。

items.en: Eighteenth and nineteenth century naturalists fixed the word for the offspring of two species, and breeding made it a practical agricultural term.
items.cn: 18 至 19 世纪的自然学家把这个词固定为两个物种的后代，育种又使它成为实用的农业术语。

items.en: The twentieth century extended hybrid to vehicles, systems and words, where two sources are combined in one unit.
items.cn: 20 世纪把 hybrid 扩展到车辆、系统与词语，指两个来源被组合进同一个单位。

items.en: Source uncertain (root): the link of Latin hybrida to Greek hybris is one hypothesis among several, and the earliest English use is dated only to the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 来源不确定（词根）：把拉丁 hybrida 与希腊 hybris 联系起来只是若干假说之一；英语最早使用只能定在 16 世纪。

note.en: Group one holds forms from the same hybrid family that are easily swapped; group two holds words for crossed or mixed things.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 hybrid 词族、容易被替换的形式；第二组是表示杂交或混合事物的词。

entries.definition: To produce a hybrid; hybrid is the product or the adjective, hybridize is the action.
entries.definitionCN: 指产生杂交后代；hybrid 是产物或形容词，hybridize 是动作。

entries.definition: The process or technique of making hybrids; it names the event, not the offspring.
entries.definitionCN: 指制造杂交后代的过程或技术；命名事件，而非后代。

entries.definition: The condition or quality of being hybrid; it is an abstract state noun.
entries.definitionCN: 指作为杂交体的状况或性质；是抽象状态名词。

entries.definition: The quality of being mixed, especially in cultural studies; it is broader and more theoretical than hybrid.
entries.definitionCN: 指混合的性质，尤用于文化研究；比 hybrid 更宽泛、更理论化。

entries.definition: An animal or plant produced by crossing two breeds; it stresses deliberate breeding rather than any combination.
entries.definitionCN: 指两个品种杂交产生的动植物；强调有意繁育，而非任何组合。

entries.definition: An animal of mixed breed, especially a dog; it often carries a negative tone that hybrid does not.
entries.definitionCN: 指混血动物，尤指狗；常带贬义，而 hybrid 不带。

entries.definition: A combination of substances or things; it does not imply that the parts produced a new individual.
entries.definitionCN: 指物质或事物的组合；不暗示各部分产生了一个新个体。

entries.definition: Something assembled from distinct parts; it stresses structure, while hybrid stresses the crossing of sources.
entries.definitionCN: 指由不同部分组装而成；强调结构，而 hybrid 强调来源的交叉。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: The base hybrid names a cross, and -ize and -ization build the action and the process.
normal.cn: 词基 hybrid 命名一次杂交，-ize 与 -ization 构成动作与过程。

normal.en: The family runs hybrid, hybridize, hybridization, hybridism, hybridity, hybridoma.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 hybrid、hybridize、hybridization、hybridism、hybridity、hybridoma。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: hybrid species, hybrid car, hybrid system.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：杂交物种、混合动力汽车、混合系统。

normal.en: Two parents, one offspring: that is the core picture behind every sense.
normal.cn: 两个亲本，一个后代：这就是所有义项背后的核心图像。

normal.en: In agriculture, hybrid vigor means the cross grows better than either parent.
normal.cn: 在农业中，杂种优势指杂交后代比任一亲本长得更好。

abstract.en: Picture two rivers joining and carrying water from both valleys.
abstract.cn: 想象两条河汇合，同时带来两个山谷的水。

abstract.en: Picture a song that uses the melody of one tradition and the rhythm of another.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌用一种传统的旋律、另一种传统的节奏。

abstract.en: Picture a machine with an engine and a battery sharing one body.
abstract.cn: 想象一台机器，发动机与电池共用同一个机身。

examples.en: The hybrid grew faster than either parent in the trial field.
examples.cn: 在试验田里，这个杂交后代比任一亲本长得更快。

examples.en: Hybrid rice helped raise yields across the region.
examples.cn: 杂交水稻帮助提高了整个地区的产量。

examples.en: The city's music is a hybrid of folk and electronic styles.
examples.cn: 这座城市的音乐是民谣与电子风格的混合。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「海布里德」——两株不一样的树合出一棵新树 → 杂种、混合体

root: 拉丁 hybrida「不同种类的后代；混合血统的人」；其更深来源存疑，一说与希腊 hybris「傲慢、暴烈」相关，但未确立。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one cross: two sources meet in one product, and that product is then named in biology, farming, genetics, engineering, language and culture.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项围绕一次杂交展开：两个来源在一个产物中相遇，这个产物再在生物学、农业、遗传学、工程、语言与文化中获得名称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a new tree growing between two different varieties, carrying both flavours.
core.cn: 核心意象：两株不同品种之间长出一棵新树，兼具两种风味。

branches.en: ORGANISM AND GENES: the basic offspring, and the same individual seen as a mix of alleles.
branches.cn: 生物体与基因：基本后代，以及从等位基因混合角度看同一只个体。

branches.en: AGRICULTURE: a repeated cross becomes a named variety sold as seed.
branches.cn: 农业：重复的杂交成为有名称、可售卖的种子品种。

branches.en: GENERAL AND CULTURAL MIXTURE: any combination, including cultures and cuisines.
branches.cn: 一般与文化混合：任何组合，包括文化与菜系。

branches.en: ENGINEERING: two power sources or two methods share one machine or plan.
branches.cn: 工程：两种动力源或两种方法共用一台机器或一个方案。

branches.en: LANGUAGE: a word built from elements of different languages.
branches.cn: 语言：由不同语言成分构成的词。

intro.en: Hybrid is a bare Latin noun used as a base; -ize and -ization turn it into the verb and the process noun, while -ism and -ity name states.
intro.cn: hybrid 是作词基使用的拉丁名词；-ize 与 -ization 把它变成动词与过程名词，-ism 与 -ity 则命名状态。

latinIntro.en: Latin hybrida is the source; the suffixes -ize and -ization came through French from Latin -izare and -izatio, themselves from Greek.
latinIntro.cn: 来源是拉丁 hybrida；后缀 -ize 与 -ization 经法语来自拉丁 -izare 与 -izatio，而后者又源自希腊语。

items.example: The hybrid carries traits from both parents.
items.exampleCN: 杂交后代携带两个亲本的性状。

items.example: Hybridize means to make a hybrid.
items.exampleCN: hybridize 意为使成为杂交体。

items.example: The two species hybridize in the wild.
items.exampleCN: 这两个物种在野外杂交。

items.example: Hybridism is common where ranges overlap.
items.exampleCN: 在分布区重叠处，杂交状态很常见。

items.example: Hybridity is a theme in cultural studies.
items.exampleCN: 混合性是文化研究的一个主题。

items.meaning: a fused cell line used to make antibodies
items.meaningCN: 用于制造抗体的融合细胞系
items.example: The hybridoma produces one kind of antibody.

items.meaning: using both fuel and electric power
items.meaningCN: 同时使用燃料与电力的
items.exampleCN: 混合电动公交车降低了燃料消耗。

definition_zh: 水圈；地球上全部水体的总称；行星的水层
definition_en: the whole body of water on a planet, including oceans, ice, groundwater, lakes, rivers and atmospheric vapour
core_image: 教室里的透明地球仪上，蓝色薄膜从海面一直裹到云底，薄得像一层漆
scene: 教室里摆着一只透明地球仪，蓝色薄膜从海面一直包到云层底部。The hydrosphere includes the oceans, the ice caps, the groundwater and the water held in the air.
sceneCN: 这里取第 1 个义项（地球上全部水体的总称）；句意为水圈包括海洋、冰盖、地下水以及悬浮在空气中的水。

pos.zh: 名词：水圈；地球全部水体；行星的水层

derivatives.zh: 由「水圈」加形容词词尾构成，义为「水圈的；水圈内的」
由希腊表示「水」的成分构成的构词成分，用于构成与水有关的术语
由希腊表示「球」的成分构成的构词成分，用于构成圈层名称

senses.title: All the water on Earth
senses.definition: the total mass of water on Earth, in every state and every reservoir
senses.definitionCN: 指地球上以各种状态存在于各处的全部水体
senses.example: The hydrosphere stores most of its water in the oceans.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈把大部分水储存在海洋里。
senses.why: The word names a sphere only because the total is imagined as one connected body.
senses.whyCN: 这个词把它称作「球」，只是因为人们把全部水量想象成一个连通的整体。

senses.title: The water shell of the planet
senses.definition: the water layer viewed as a shell surrounding the solid Earth
senses.definitionCN: 指把水看作包在固体地球外面的一层
senses.example: The hydrosphere forms a thin, broken shell around the planet.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈在地球外面形成一层薄而不连续的外壳。
senses.why: Earth-system science divides the planet into shells, and water is one of them.
senses.whyCN: 地球系统科学把行星分成若干圈层，水是其中之一。

senses.title: A subsystem of the Earth system
senses.definition: the water component that exchanges matter and energy with the atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere
senses.definitionCN: 指与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈交换物质与能量的水的部分
senses.example: Water moves constantly between the hydrosphere and the atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 水在水圈与大气圈之间不断移动。
senses.why: Once the shell is treated as a system, its exchanges with neighbouring shells become the main story.
senses.whyCN: 一旦把这层当作系统，它与相邻圈层的交换就成了主要故事。

senses.title: A planet's water inventory
senses.definition: the water held by another planet or moon, whatever its state
senses.definitionCN: 指另一颗行星或卫星所拥有的水，不论其状态
senses.example: The Martian hydrosphere is now mostly frozen or buried.
senses.exampleCN: 火星的水圈如今大多冻结或埋在地下。
senses.why: Planetary scientists extended the terrestrial term to any world with water.
senses.whyCN: 行星科学家把地球上的这个术语扩展到任何有水的天体。

senses.title: The slow reservoir of the water cycle
senses.definition: the part of the water system that stores water for a long time, especially groundwater and ice
senses.definitionCN: 指水系统中长期储存水的部分，尤其是地下水与冰
senses.example: Groundwater is the slowest part of the hydrosphere to renew.
senses.exampleCN: 地下水是水圈中更新最慢的部分。
senses.why: Storage time separates a reservoir from a channel, and the phrase covers both.
senses.whyCN: 储存时间把储库与通道区分开来，而这条术语两者都包括。

senses.title: The freshwater share
senses.definition: the small fraction of the total that is fresh rather than saline
senses.definitionCN: 指总水量中非咸水的那一小部分
senses.example: Only a small fraction of the hydrosphere is fresh water.
senses.exampleCN: 水圈中只有一小部分是淡水。
senses.why: The whole is mostly salt water, so the useful part needs a separate label.
senses.whyCN: 整体大多是咸水，因此有用的那一小部分需要一个单独的说法。

senses.title: Water as a managed resource
senses.definition: the water system considered as a resource to be measured, allocated and protected
senses.definitionCN: 指被计量、分配与保护的水系统
senses.example: Engineers treat the hydrosphere as a resource with limits.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师把水圈当作有限资源来对待。
senses.why: Resource language shifts the focus from description to allocation.
senses.whyCN: 资源语言把重点从描述转向分配。

senses.title: The water of a closed local system
senses.definition: the water contained in an isolated body such as a lake, a cave or a sealed basin
senses.definitionCN: 指湖泊、洞穴或封闭盆地等孤立水体中所含的水
senses.example: The cave's hydrosphere is cut off from the surface.
senses.exampleCN: 这个洞穴的水体与地表隔绝。
senses.why: The same word scales down to any bounded volume of water.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也能缩小到任何有边界的水体。

intro.en: Hydrosphere joins Greek hydor, water, with Greek sphaira, a ball, through the Latin form sphaera. The compound was coined in the nineteenth century as a parallel to atmosphere and later lithosphere; the precise coinage date is uncertain.
intro.cn: 这个词把希腊语中表示「水」的词与表示「球」的词组合起来，后者经拉丁语形式进入欧洲语言。这个合成词在十九世纪仿照「大气圈」造出，后来又有了「岩石圈」等并列词；确切造词年份不确定。

items.en: Hydor meant water, and its stem supplies the first half of hydrology, hydrate and hydrosphere.
items.cn: 这个词意为水，其词干构成「水文学」「水合物」「水圈」等词的前半部分。

items.en: Sphaira meant a ball or a globe, the shape of a celestial body.
items.cn: 这个词意为球、球体，即天体的形状。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as sphaera, which passed into the European languages.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊名词，后来又传入欧洲各语言。

items.en: English took the Latin noun for a round solid and later for any domain of activity.
items.cn: 英语借入这个拉丁名词，先指圆球体，后来指任何活动领域。

items.en: The compound was formed as a scientific parallel to atmosphere, naming the water shell of the planet.
items.cn: 这个合成词作为「大气圈」的科学类比而造，指地球的水层。

items.en: Twentieth-century Earth science made it one of several interacting shells, alongside atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere.
items.cn: 二十世纪的地球科学把它与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈并列，作为相互作用的圈层之一。

note.en: The first group shares the water or sphere element; the second group names neighbouring shells and water bodies.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示「水」或「球」的成分；第二组是相邻圈层与具体水体的说法。

entries.definition: The air shell of a planet, coined with the same sphere element.
entries.definitionCN: 行星的空气层，用同一个「球」成分构成。

entries.definition: The rocky shell of a planet, built to match the water term.
entries.definitionCN: 行星的岩石层，按水的术语仿造。

entries.definition: The zone of life, another shell in the same family.
entries.definitionCN: 指生命存在的区域，同一族里的另一个圈层。

entries.definition: The scientific study of water, sharing the water root.
entries.definitionCN: 研究水的学科，共享「水」词根。

entries.definition: Half of a sphere, a word built with the same ball element.
entries.definitionCN: 指球的一半，用同一个「球」成分构成。

entries.definition: The circulation of water among ocean, air, land and life.
entries.definitionCN: 指水在海洋、大气、陆地与生物之间的循环。

entries.definition: An underground layer that stores and transmits groundwater.
entries.definitionCN: 指储存并输送地下水的地下岩层。

entries.definition: The area from which water drains into one river system.
entries.definitionCN: 指向同一河系汇水的区域。

entries.definition: A natural or artificial store of water.
entries.definitionCN: 指天然或人工的水储库。

entries.definition: The frozen part of the water system, ice and snow.
entries.definitionCN: 指水系统中冻结的部分，即冰与雪。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations follow water plus ball: a blue film wrapped around a globe.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想沿着「水」加「球」展开：一层裹住地球仪的蓝色薄膜。

normal.en: Water plus ball gives a water shell around a planet.
normal.cn: 水加球，就是行星外面的一层水壳。

normal.en: The ocean holds nearly all of it; ice, groundwater and vapour are the small shares.
normal.cn: 海洋占去几乎全部；冰、地下水与水汽只占小份。

normal.en: It sits beside atmosphere, lithosphere and biosphere in the same family of shells.
normal.cn: 它与大气圈、岩石圈、生物圈并列为同一族圈层。

normal.en: Groundwater is the slowest reservoir in the cycle.
normal.cn: 地下水是水循环中更新最慢的储库。

normal.en: Planetary scientists speak of a Martian hydrosphere, mostly frozen.
normal.cn: 行星科学家会说火星水圈，其中大部分已冻结。

abstract.en: A sphere is a way of seeing one connected thing where there are thousands of separate pools.
abstract.cn: 「球」是一种看法：把成千上万处分散的水看成一件连通的事。

abstract.en: Water is the part of a planet that keeps changing its address.
abstract.cn: 水是行星上不断更换住址的那一部分。

abstract.en: Every resource phrase begins as a description and ends as a budget.
abstract.cn: 每个资源说法都从描述开始，以预算告终。

examples.en: The hydrosphere exchanges heat with the atmosphere over every ocean surface.
examples.cn: 水圈在每一片海面上与大气圈交换热量。

examples.en: Most of the hydrosphere is salt water, so fresh water needs separate accounting.
examples.cn: 水圈的大部分是咸水，因此淡水需要单独核算。

examples.en: A planet's hydrosphere may be liquid, frozen or held as vapour.
examples.cn: 一颗行星的水圈可以是液态、冻结的，或以水汽形式存在。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「海德若斯菲尔」——海的水（海德）裹成一个球（斯菲尔），就是水圈：水圈、地球上的全部水体

root: 希腊语 hydor「水」加 sphaira「球」，后者经拉丁语 sphaera 进入欧洲语言；合成词于十九世纪仿「大气圈」造出，确切年份不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses treat one blue film as total water, as a shell, as a system, as a planet's inventory, as storage, as freshwater, as a resource and as a sealed local pool.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项把同一层蓝色薄膜分别看作全部水量、一个圈层、一个系统、一颗行星的水量、储库、淡水、资源，以及局部封闭的水体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin blue skin over a classroom globe, running from sea surface to cloud base.
core.cn: 核心意象：教室地球仪上的一层蓝色薄皮，从海面一直铺到云底。

branches.en: THE WHOLE AND THE SHELL: all water at once, imagined as a layer around the solid Earth.
branches.cn: 整体与外壳：一次性看全部水，把它想象成包住固体地球的一层。

branches.en: THE SYSTEM: water exchanging matter and energy with air, rock and life.
branches.cn: 系统：水与空气、岩石、生命交换物质与能量。

branches.en: OTHER WORLDS: the same term extended to any planet's water.
branches.cn: 别的世界：同一术语扩展到任何行星的水。

branches.en: STORAGE AND THE USEFUL PART: slow reservoirs, and the small fresh fraction.
branches.cn: 储存与可用部分：缓慢的储库，以及那一小份淡水。

branches.en: FROM BUDGET TO BOUNDARY: water allocated as a resource, and water sealed inside a local body.
branches.cn: 从预算到边界：作为资源分配的水，以及封闭在局部水体中的水。

intro.en: The word is a Greek compound wearing a Latinised sphere; both halves are transparent and productive.
intro.cn: 这个词是希腊合成词，只把「球」写成了拉丁化形式；两半都清楚且能产。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplied the form of the sphere word; the water element is Greek and has no native Latin root here.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了「球」这个词的书写形式；「水」的成分出自希腊语，此处没有本土拉丁词根。

items.example: It is the first element of hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它是「水圈」的第一个成分。

items.example: It is the second element of hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它是「水圈」的第二个成分。

items.example: Latin passed the form to later European languages.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把这个形式传给后来的欧洲语言。

items.example: English uses it for both shapes and fields.
items.exampleCN: 英语用它指形状，也指领域。

items.example: It builds atmosphere, biosphere and hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「大气圈」「生物圈」「水圈」等词。

items.example: It builds hydrology, hydroelectric and hydrosphere.
items.exampleCN: 它构成「水文学」「水电」「水圈」等词。

items.example: The adjective adds a Latin-derived ending to the compound.
items.exampleCN: 形容词给合成词加了源自拉丁语的词尾。

items.example: It is the Latin word for water, used in aquifer and aquatic.
items.exampleCN: 它是拉丁语中表示「水」的词，用于「含水层」「水生」等词。

items.example: It is built on the same pattern with a Greek word for cold.
items.exampleCN: 它按同一模式加希腊语表示「寒冷」的词构成。

derivatives.zh: 由「水圈」加形容词词尾构成，义为「水圈的」
由希腊「水」成分构成的构词成分，用于构成与水有关的术语
由希腊「球」成分构成的构词成分，用于构成圈层名称
